source: Fan-written mastery names and descriptions based on PotionMaker-REA localized potion names and each material’s lore.
note: These 75 records are remake mastery achievements. Each title pairs a potion with its signature material; each description ties reaching maximum enhancement to that ingredient’s origin and brewing role. Original Pio/Tia comments appear in the Potion Book and unlock at the potion’s maximum level.
provenance: Original game titles and potion descriptions remain in the Potion Book. Achievement names and descriptions are fan-written; mastery mechanics are a remake feature.

0-0.title: Sample Red Potion · Red herb Pinnacle
0-0.lore: At level 3, Sample Red Potion reaches its pinnacle through Red herb. Red herbs grow along sun-warmed stone walls, where their pigment deepens after rain. A short steep lends the Sample Red Potion its plain color and gentle, beginner-friendly character.

0-1.title: Baby HP Potion · Sturdy mushroom Pinnacle
0-1.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Baby HP Potion, perfected with Sturdy mushroom: Sturdy mushrooms push up beneath old orchard roots and store the damp chill of the soil. Their soft cap thickens the Infant HP Potion into a child-sized, soothing brew.

0-2.title: Raspberry Potion · Fruit of power Pinnacle
0-2.lore: Mastery records Raspberry Potion at level 5, with Fruit of power defining the finished brew. Power fruit ripens on steep terraces and tastes brighter after a clear night. Its tart juice gives Raspberry Potion its dessert-like finish without hiding the useful warmth beneath.

0-3.title: Small HP Potion · Rainbow bird feathers Pinnacle
0-3.lore: Only the final refinement earns Small HP Potion its Rainbow bird feathers crest. Rainbow birds shed these feathers at the edge of the spring migration route. Their fine shafts dissolve into a portable Small HP Potion with a faint, honest bitterness.

0-4.title: Collagen Potion · Rainbow bird's egg Pinnacle
0-4.lore: Level 5 marks Collagen Potion complete; its signature ingredient is Rainbow bird's egg. The egg’s shell is flecked by minerals from the cliff nests where it is laid. Its nourishing yolk smooths Collagen Potion into a refreshing, vegetable-like tonic.

0-5.title: Homemade HP Potion · Strange powder Pinnacle
0-5.lore: At level 5, Homemade HP Potion reaches its pinnacle through Strange powder. This powder gathers in dry hollows where old roots leave a pale mineral dust. A careful pinch gives Home HP Potion its steady, travel-ready body; too much settles like flour.

0-6.title: Normal HP Potion · Drunkagora Pinnacle
0-6.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Normal HP Potion, perfected with Drunkagora: Drunkagora grows around springs frequented by thirsty woodland beasts. Its mellow root rounds out Normal HP Potion, the dependable flask travelers reach for between towns.

0-7.title: Carbonated Cherry Potion · Manticore fur Pinnacle
0-7.lore: Mastery records Carbonated Cherry Potion at level 5, with Manticore fur defining the finished brew. Manticore fur catches static on the high ridges and crackles when brushed. That lively charge helps Carbonated Cherry Potion hold a vigorous fizz and a surprisingly firm effect.

0-8.title: Large HP Potion · Mom's Heart Pinnacle
0-8.lore: Only the final refinement earns Large HP Potion its Mom's Heart crest. The Life ledger depicts Mom’s Heart as a folded pink letter closed with a red heart seal, not a fruit. Its affectionate ink is steeped into Large HP Potion, giving the travel-size restorative a keepsake warmth that suits its generous bottle.

0-9.title: Blessed HP Potion · Dancing flower Pinnacle
0-9.lore: Level 5 marks Blessed HP Potion complete; its signature ingredient is Dancing flower. Dancing flowers turn toward music carried across the valley and collect dew in their cupped petals. Their bright pollen gives Blessing HP Potion a clean, almost sacred finish.

0-10.title: Strawberry Potion · S Class strawberry jam Pinnacle
0-10.lore: At level 5, Strawberry Potion reaches its pinnacle through S Class strawberry jam. S-class strawberries come from a small jam orchard where the berries are reduced slowly instead of boiled hard. The preserve sets Strawberry Potion into a sweet, glossy jelly texture.

0-11.title: Elixir of Strength · Eye of giant bat Pinnacle
0-11.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Elixir of Strength, perfected with Eye of giant bat: Giant bats shed their eyeshine as a crystallized membrane near cave roosts; the collected lens is inert once properly sealed. It focuses the Elixir of Strength’s brief surge into a concentrated, measured dose.

0-12.title: Shining HP Potion · Flower fairy wings Pinnacle
0-12.lore: Mastery records Shining HP Potion at level 5, with Flower fairy wings defining the finished brew. Flower fairies leave these wings caught in dew nets at dawn. Their scarlet shimmer refracts through Shining HP Potion, making the bottle glow like a tiny lantern.

0-13.title: Advanced HP Potion · Fang of fire dragon Pinnacle
0-13.lore: Only the final refinement earns Advanced HP Potion its Fang of fire dragon crest. Fire dragons shed their fangs when the old enamel loosens, and licensed collectors cool them before transport. A sliver contributes the durable, high-grade base of Advanced HP Potion.

0-14.title: Fire resistance Potion · Red crystal Pinnacle
0-14.lore: Level 5 marks Fire resistance Potion complete; its signature ingredient is Red crystal. Red crystals form where lava meets iron-rich earth and then cools over many seasons. Their heat-stable facets bind the Fire Resistance Potion so it keeps its protective warmth.

0-15.title: Enriched HP Potion · Meteor scroll Pinnacle
0-15.lore: At level 5, Enriched HP Potion reaches its pinnacle through Meteor scroll. Meteor scrolls are fragments of star maps scorched during a meteor shower and preserved by observatory scribes. Their compressed ink gives Enriched HP Potion its dense, powerful core.

0-16.title: Elixir of Rage · Succubu`s tear Pinnacle
0-16.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Elixir of Rage, perfected with Succubu`s tear: Succubi leave a single tear when a vow is broken, which collectors bind in a silver ampoule. Its fierce pulse makes Elixir of Rage hit hard, while the recipe keeps the rest of the blend spare.

0-17.title: Celestial HP Potion · Rune of seraph Pinnacle
0-17.lore: Mastery records Celestial HP Potion at level 5, with Rune of seraph defining the finished brew. Seraph runes are copied from a choir stone that rings only at sunrise. Their balanced lines harmonize the Celestial HP Potion into a polished, almost heavenly drink.

0-18.title: Ancient HP Potion · Fire dragon scale Pinnacle
0-18.lore: Only the final refinement earns Ancient HP Potion its Fire dragon scale crest. Fire dragon scales are shed during the ancient molt and cured in ash-free air. Their layered pattern stabilizes Ancient HP Potion, an old restorative whose flavor has never been its selling point.

0-19.title: Elixir of Legends · Stone of Sage Pinnacle
0-19.lore: Level 5 marks Elixir of Legends complete; its signature ingredient is Stone of Sage. Sage stones are said to form around a philosopher’s abandoned hourglass, slowly gathering its patient mineral pulse. Ground into the Elixir of Legends, they support the recipe’s impossible promise of lasting life.

0-20.title: Elixir of Dawn · Pendant of dawn Pinnacle
0-20.lore: At level 5, Elixir of Dawn reaches its pinnacle through Pendant of dawn. Pendant stones are found where dawn first reaches the Underworld’s upper caverns. Their pale gleam gives Elixir of Dawn its strange passage between waking light and shadow.

0-21.title: Cursed Bloody Reagent · Cursed Ruby ring Pinnacle
0-21.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Cursed Bloody Reagent, perfected with Cursed Ruby ring: Cursed ruby rings are recovered from sealed experiment drawers, where their red glass has absorbed years of unfinished notes. A trace lends Bloody Cursed Reagents their binding mark for controlled trials.

0-22.title: Demon's Minor HP Potion · Demon`s red horn Pinnacle
0-22.lore: Mastery records Demon's Minor HP Potion at level 5, with Demon`s red horn defining the finished brew. Demon horns grow in ridged layers that hold a little warmth from the Underworld. A shaved curl gives Demon’s Minor HP Potion its compact, adventurer-friendly restorative kick.

0-23.title: Red Plague Serum · Red plague of spore Pinnacle
0-23.lore: Only the final refinement earns Red Plague Serum its Red plague of spore crest. Red plague spores are collected from a quarantined crimson shelf fungus and rendered inactive for the sealed serum recipe. Their patterned culture gives Red Plague Serum its wide-ranging experimental profile.

0-24.title: Red Essence of Pride · Lucifer`s red tears Pinnacle
0-24.lore: Level 5 marks Red Essence of Pride complete; its signature ingredient is Lucifer`s red tears. Lucifer’s red tears are crystallized droplets found on the edge of a pride shrine after its keeper departs. Their concentrated gleam becomes the finishing note in Red Essence of Pride.

1-0.title: Sample Blue potion · Blue herb Pinnacle
1-0.lore: At level 3, Sample Blue potion reaches its pinnacle through Blue herb. Blue herbs grow in misty ravines and draw their cool color from mineral-rich runoff. Their mild infusion gives Sample Blue Potion its simple beginner’s profile and clean, quiet finish.

1-1.title: Infant MP potion · Clever mushroom Pinnacle
1-1.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Infant MP potion, perfected with Clever mushroom: Clever mushrooms grow in rings around fallen beech trunks, where their bitter cap develops slowly. They give Infant MP Potion a gentle, focused base suited to a small serving.

1-2.title: Blueberry potion · Fruit of wisdom Pinnacle
1-2.lore: Mastery records Blueberry potion at level 5, with Fruit of wisdom defining the finished brew. Wisdom fruit ripens in the university gardens after students leave for summer. Its tart skin brightens Blueberry Potion, a snack-like blend that keeps its thoughtful, crisp edge.

1-3.title: Small MP potion · Bluebird feathers Pinnacle
1-3.lore: Only the final refinement earns Small MP potion its Bluebird feathers crest. Bluebirds drop these feathers beside cold mountain streams during their annual molt. Their light barbs make Small MP Potion easy to carry, with a curious but restrained taste.

1-4.title: Mineral potion · Bluebird's egg Pinnacle
1-4.lore: Level 5 marks Mineral potion complete; its signature ingredient is Bluebird's egg. Bluebird eggs collect a mineral bloom from nests built over limestone pools. The mineral-rich yolk rounds Mineral Potion into a nourishing drink with a gentle herbal-tea note.

1-5.title: Home MP potion · Suspicious powder Pinnacle
1-5.lore: At level 5, Home MP potion reaches its pinnacle through Suspicious powder. Suspicious powder forms in abandoned observatory cupboards where old cooling charms have powdered the dust. A measured dose settles Home MP Potion into a fever-soothing, upright-stored tonic.

1-6.title: Normal MP potion · Whyragora Pinnacle
1-6.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Normal MP potion, perfected with Whyragora: Whyragora roots thread through shaded creek banks and absorb the steady rhythm of running water. Their economical infusion gives Normal MP Potion a strong effect for an everyday traveler’s price.

1-7.title: Carbonated soda potion · Werewolf fur Pinnacle
1-7.lore: Mastery records Carbonated soda potion at level 5, with Werewolf fur defining the finished brew. Werewolf fur is gathered from the silver undercoat left after a winter molt. Its springy fibers help Carbonated Soda Potion keep a lively head, though the potency stays modest.

1-8.title: Large MP potion · Dad's Youth Pinnacle
1-8.lore: Only the final refinement earns Large MP potion its Dad's Youth crest. Dad’s Youth is shown as a pale blue letter with a blue heart seal, its careful handwriting preserved in the Mana archive. The ink dissolves into Large MP Potion as a steady, cool infusion, while the large bottle keeps enough of the old message for a long journey.

1-9.title: Blessing MP potion · Dreamy flower Pinnacle
1-9.lore: Level 5 marks Blessing MP potion complete; its signature ingredient is Dreamy flower. Dreamy flowers bloom beside pools that mirror the night sky even at noon. Their calm scent softens Blessing MP Potion and leaves the finished brew unusually clear.

1-10.title: Grape potion · S Class grape jam Pinnacle
1-10.lore: At level 5, Grape potion reaches its pinnacle through S Class grape jam. S-class grapes are pressed in small batches until their skins lend the syrup a deep violet gloss. The jam turns Grape Potion into a sweet, jelly-like drink with a lingering fruit note.

1-11.title: Elixir of Wisdom · Eye of gargoyle Pinnacle
1-11.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Elixir of Wisdom, perfected with Eye of gargoyle: Gargoyle eyes are polished stones shed from old rooftop statues after storms. Their faceted focus sharpens Elixir of Wisdom’s temporary clarity, a favorite among students with looming exams.

1-12.title: Shining MP potion · Lake fairy wings Pinnacle
1-12.lore: Mastery records Shining MP potion at level 5, with Lake fairy wings defining the finished brew. Lake fairies leave blue wings on reeds after moonlit dances over still water. Their cool iridescence gives Shining MP Potion a luminous blue glow without clouding the liquid.

1-13.title: Advanced MP potion · Fang of water dragon Pinnacle
1-13.lore: Only the final refinement earns Advanced MP potion its Fang of water dragon crest. Water dragons shed their fangs near deep river bends where the current wears the enamel smooth. A tiny shaving lends Advanced MP Potion its seasoned, high-effect base.

1-14.title: Frost resistance potion · Blue crystal Pinnacle
1-14.lore: Level 5 marks Frost resistance potion complete; its signature ingredient is Blue crystal. Blue crystals grow in glacier caves as meltwater freezes around ancient mineral seams. Their cold-stable structure anchors Frost Resistance Potion and helps it keep a crisp finish.

1-15.title: Enriched MP potion · Blizzard scroll Pinnacle
1-15.lore: At level 5, Enriched MP potion reaches its pinnacle through Blizzard scroll. Blizzard scrolls are inked on frost-silk during the annual whiteout and sealed before the thaw. Their condensed runes make Enriched MP Potion exceptionally dense and effective.

1-16.title: Elixir of Calmness · Siren's Tear Pinnacle
1-16.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Elixir of Calmness, perfected with Siren's Tear: A siren’s tear is caught in a shell at the point where song becomes silence. Its quiet pulse steadies Elixir of Calmness, helping the blend sharpen concentration without a dramatic aftertaste.

1-17.title: Celestial MP potion · Runes of cherub Pinnacle
1-17.lore: Mastery records Celestial MP potion at level 5, with Runes of cherub defining the finished brew. Cherub runes are copied from a marble cradle whose carvings remain warm in winter. Their balanced pattern gives Celestial MP Potion its smooth, otherworldly harmony.

1-18.title: Ancient MP Potion · Water dragon scale Pinnacle
1-18.lore: Only the final refinement earns Ancient MP Potion its Water dragon scale crest. Water dragon scales are shed in deep caves and polished by underground streams. Their layered blue sheen stabilizes Ancient MP Potion, an old recipe promising magic that does not run dry.

1-19.title: Elixir of Fantasy · Stone of Deep-sea Pinnacle
1-19.lore: Level 5 marks Elixir of Fantasy complete; its signature ingredient is Stone of Deep-sea. Deep-sea stones are found in trenches where sunlight has never reached the seabed. Their compressed mineral memory lends Elixir of Fantasy its fabled, all-knowledge ambition.

1-20.title: Elixir of daybreak · Pendant of daybreak Pinnacle
1-20.lore: At level 6, Elixir of daybreak reaches its pinnacle through Pendant of daybreak. Daybreak pendants form in the Underworld where the first shaft of morning slips through a cavern roof. Their pale blue gleam guides Elixir of Daybreak between two very different skies.

1-21.title: Ashy cursed reagents · Cursed Sapphire Ring Pinnacle
1-21.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Ashy cursed reagents, perfected with Cursed Sapphire Ring: Cursed sapphire rings are recovered from a locked cabinet of unfinished blue experiments. Their cool trace marks Ashy Cursed Reagents as a measured component for controlled studies.

1-22.title: Demon's minor MP potion · Demon's blue horn Pinnacle
1-22.lore: Mastery records Demon's minor MP potion at level 6, with Demon's blue horn defining the finished brew. Blue demon horns hold a cool undertone beneath their dark ridges. Their carefully shaved dust gives Demon’s Minor MP Potion a practical boost for Underworld expeditions.

1-23.title: Blue plague serum · Blue plague of spore Pinnacle
1-23.lore: Only the final refinement earns Blue plague serum its Blue plague of spore crest. Blue plague spores grow in a sealed cave garden where moonlight turns every thread cobalt. Rendered inactive for the formula, they give Blue Plague Serum its broad experimental character.

1-24.title: Blue essence of pride · Lucifer's blue tears Pinnacle
1-24.lore: Level 6 marks Blue essence of pride complete; its signature ingredient is Lucifer's blue tears. Lucifer’s blue tears crystallize where a pride shrine meets a cold spring. Their sharp blue glint finishes Blue Essence of Pride with a note that seems to reflect more than the bottle.

2-0.title: Sample Yellow potion · Yellow herb Pinnacle
2-0.lore: At level 3, Sample Yellow potion reaches its pinnacle through Yellow herb. Yellow herbs grow on windy hillsides where the leaves face the sun from dawn onward. Their mild color and easy infusion make Sample Yellow Potion a straightforward first brew.

2-1.title: Infant SP potion · Lively mushroom Pinnacle
2-1.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Infant SP potion, perfected with Lively mushroom: Lively mushrooms spring up after warm summer rain and seem to bounce when the basket shifts. Their sweet, buoyant infusion makes Infant SP Potion gentle on a small stomach.

2-2.title: Orange potion · Fruit of spirit Pinnacle
2-2.lore: Mastery records Orange potion at level 3, with Fruit of spirit defining the finished brew. Spirit fruit grows in orchards planted near old festival grounds, where the trees retain a bright, celebratory scent. Its citrus sweetness forms Orange Potion, a popular treat with a spirited finish.

2-3.title: Small SP potion · Wyvern feathers Pinnacle
2-3.lore: Only the final refinement earns Small SP potion its Wyvern feathers crest. Wyverns drop these feathers while circling warm updrafts above the cliffs. Their light fibers leave Small SP Potion portable and give the compact blend a pleasant sour edge.

2-4.title: Vitamin potion · Wyvern's egg Pinnacle
2-4.lore: Level 5 marks Vitamin potion complete; its signature ingredient is Wyvern's egg. Wyvern eggs develop in sunlit nests where the shell gathers a vitamin-rich golden bloom. Their nourishing contents give Vitamin Potion its refreshing, tea-like character.

2-5.title: Home SP potion · Dangerous powder Pinnacle
2-5.lore: At level 6, Home SP potion reaches its pinnacle through Dangerous powder. Dangerous powder is scraped from the dry heart of a storm-burnt seedpod and stabilized by the guild. A little of its wakeful warmth gives Home SP Potion a steady, sleep-resistant profile.

2-6.title: Normal SP potion · Whatdragora Pinnacle
2-6.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Normal SP potion, perfected with Whatdragora: Whatdragora root grows where three trails meet and takes on a different scent from each path. Its versatile broth lends Normal SP Potion a modest, travel-friendly energy lift.

2-7.title: Carbonated lemon potion · Kobold fur Pinnacle
2-7.lore: Mastery records Carbonated lemon potion at level 8, with Kobold fur defining the finished brew. Kobolds leave their winter underfur in warm basalt dens, where it picks up a faint lemony mineral scent. The resilient fibers help Carbonated Lemon Potion keep its crisp fizz and strong kick.

2-8.title: Large SP potion · Uncle's Mystery Pinnacle
2-8.lore: Only the final refinement earns Large SP potion its Uncle's Mystery crest. Uncle’s Mystery appears as a yellow letter bearing a golden heart, addressed but never fully explained in the Stamina collection. A measured wash of its curious ink gives Large SP Potion a bright, sustaining finish, bottled beautifully for the road ahead.

2-9.title: Blessing SP potion · Singing flower Pinnacle
2-9.lore: Level 10 marks Blessing SP potion complete; its signature ingredient is Singing flower. Singing flowers bloom beside the old stone stage and vibrate softly when wind crosses their petals. Their resonant nectar lends Blessing SP Potion a bright, unexpectedly potent finish.

2-10.title: Potion of Riddle · Jam of mystery Pinnacle
2-10.lore: At level 11, Potion of Riddle reaches its pinnacle through Jam of mystery. Mystery jam is made from fruit gathered at the edge of the riddle grove, where no two baskets smell quite alike. It gives Potion of Riddle its glossy jelly texture and refreshing sweetness.

2-11.title: Elixir of Energy · Eye of ogre Pinnacle
2-11.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Elixir of Energy, perfected with Eye of ogre: Ogre eyes are polished amber stones found in the ruins of a watchtower. Their warm focus gives Elixir of Energy a temporary lift that city workers favor during long shifts.

2-12.title: Shining SP potion · Forest fairy wings Pinnacle
2-12.lore: Mastery records Shining SP potion at level 13, with Forest fairy wings defining the finished brew. Forest fairies leave golden wings caught on bramble flowers after autumn dances. Their warm shimmer scatters through Shining SP Potion, turning the bottle into a little sunbeam.

2-13.title: Advanced SP potion · Fang of thunder dragon Pinnacle
2-13.lore: Only the final refinement earns Advanced SP potion its Fang of thunder dragon crest. Thunder dragons shed fangs on storm peaks where lightning has glazed the enamel. A fine shaving gives Advanced SP Potion its seasoned, high-impact foundation.

2-14.title: Electric resistance potion · Gold crystal Pinnacle
2-14.lore: Level 15 marks Electric resistance potion complete; its signature ingredient is Gold crystal. Gold crystals form inside hills struck repeatedly by summer lightning. Their conductive lattice anchors Electric Resistance Potion and helps the protective blend hold its bright finish.

2-15.title: Enriched SP potion · Thunderbolt scroll Pinnacle
2-15.lore: At level 16, Enriched SP potion reaches its pinnacle through Thunderbolt scroll. Thunderbolt scrolls are written during distant storms on paper that briefly holds a spark. Their tightly packed symbols concentrate Enriched SP Potion into a dense, forceful brew.

2-16.title: Elixir of Vigor · Harpy's tear Pinnacle
2-16.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Elixir of Vigor, perfected with Harpy's tear: Harpy tears fall into highland anemones after a long flight through rough weather. Their bright, tireless pulse gives Elixir of Vigor its sustained lift without weighing down the blend.

2-17.title: Celestial SP potion · Rune of thrones Pinnacle
2-17.lore: Mastery records Celestial SP potion at level 18, with Rune of thrones defining the finished brew. Runes of thrones are copied from a golden seat buried beneath the old royal observatory. Their deliberate symmetry gives Celestial SP Potion a regal balance and exquisite finish.

2-18.title: Ancient SP Potion · Thunder dragon scale Pinnacle
2-18.lore: Only the final refinement earns Ancient SP Potion its Thunder dragon scale crest. Thunder dragon scales are shed in the storm season and tempered by mountain rain. Their golden ridges steady Ancient SP Potion, a fabled recipe said to renew youth.

2-19.title: Elixir of Hero · Stone of Glory Pinnacle
2-19.lore: Level 20 marks Elixir of Hero complete; its signature ingredient is Stone of Glory. Glory stones form in the footprints of heroes after a battle has passed into legend. Their bright mineral grain gives Elixir of Hero its mythic strength and rare, hard-to-find finish.

2-20.title: Elixir of twilight · Pendant of dusk Pinnacle
2-20.lore: At level 21, Elixir of twilight reaches its pinnacle through Pendant of dusk. Dusk pendants crystallize in the Underworld’s last-lit passage as the evening star appears above. Their amber glow shapes Elixir of Twilight, a brew balanced between day’s end and night.

2-21.title: Sunset cursed reagents · Cursed Topaz ring Pinnacle
2-21.lore: The max-level seal belongs to Sunset cursed reagents, perfected with Cursed Topaz ring: Cursed topaz rings come from a yellow-glass experiment abandoned when its inventor changed careers. A measured shaving lends Sunset Cursed Reagents their golden mark for careful trials.

2-22.title: Demon's Minor SP potion · Demon's yellow horn Pinnacle
2-22.lore: Mastery records Demon's Minor SP potion at level 23, with Demon's yellow horn defining the finished brew. Yellow demon horns carry the warm tint of the Underworld’s ember fields. Their fine powder contributes a compact restorative note to Demon’s Minor SP Potion for adventurers on the move.

2-23.title: Yellow Plague Serum · Yellow plague of spore Pinnacle
2-23.lore: Only the final refinement earns Yellow Plague Serum its Yellow plague of spore crest. Yellow plague spores form a bright lace beneath a quarantined shelf fungus and are neutralized before the serum is packed. Their varied culture gives Yellow Plague Serum its wide-ranging experimental profile.

2-24.title: Gold Essence of Pride · Lucifer's golden tears Pinnacle
2-24.lore: Level 25 marks Gold Essence of Pride complete; its signature ingredient is Lucifer's golden tears. Lucifer’s golden tears crystallize on a sunlit ledge beside an old pride shrine. Their warm gleam completes Gold Essence of Pride with a finish that looks almost molten.
